tools.name: Granola
tools.what: Turns your rough notes and the call transcript into clean notes. No bot joins the call.
tools.video: 5 AI tools that give you back 10 hours a week

tools.name: Superhuman
tools.what: Splits your inbox so important mail comes first and drafts replies in your tone.
tools.video: 5 AI tools that give you back 10 hours a week

tools.name: Reclaim
tools.what: Books focus time and habits on your calendar and moves them when meetings land.
tools.video: 5 AI tools that give you back 10 hours a week

tools.name: Zapier
tools.what: Describe a workflow in plain English and its AI builds and runs the automation.
tools.video: 5 AI tools that give you back 10 hours a week

tools.name: Gamma
tools.what: Turns a prompt or rough notes into a designed slide deck in about a minute.
tools.video: 5 AI tools that give you back 10 hours a week

tools.name: claude-mem
tools.what: Records what Claude Code does, compresses it into short notes and loads them into your next session. Open source (Apache-2.0). Install: npx claude-mem install
tools.video: Claude Code forgets everything. This fixes that.

tools.name: Mika
tools.what: An AI agent for Android that works your apps and the web on a hidden screen while you keep using your phone. Free, Apache-2.0. Needs Android 11+ and your own AI model key.
tools.video: Your phone can now use its own apps

tools.name: Floorplan
tools.what: A Claude Code and Codex plugin that draws a plain-English map of your codebase and runs a health check (keys in code, open tables, risky endpoints). MIT.
tools.video: AI built your app. Now see how it works.

tools.name: Subvocal
tools.what: YC startup building glasses that turn silently mouthed words into text using radio waves and an AI model. Prototype; the team plans to ship in Q1 2027. Source: their Show HN post.
tools.video: These glasses let you type without a sound

tools.name: Kikumap
tools.what: A free, open-source Mac menu-bar app that shows which Claude and ChatGPT chats are running, done or waiting, and lays them out as a mind map. Unofficial; macOS 13+.
tools.video: Too many AI chats open? Map them.

tools.name: Claude vs ChatGPT (Nov 2026)
tools.what: Coding: Claude Code 62 vs Codex 55. Budget: GPT-6.1 Sol scores 55 at $1.27 per task vs Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and $10.04. Hard questions: 58 vs 57, a tie. Data from Artificial Analysis, Nov 3 2026.
tools.video: Claude vs ChatGPT: the honest answer

tools.name: Claude vs Gemini (Nov 2026)
tools.what: Hard questions: Gemini 4 Carbon 59 vs Claude Opus 5.5 58. Coding agents: Claude Code 62 vs Gemini 59. Carbon is not public yet; Gemini 4 Argon, available today, scores 50. Data: Artificial Analysis, Nov 3 2026.
tools.video: Gemini passed Claude. But there's a catch.

tools.name: Is a $20 AI plan worth it?
tools.what: ChatGPT Plus $20, Claude Pro $20 ($17/mo yearly), Google AI Pro $19.99. Paying unlocks the top model (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus, Gemini 4 Argon), higher limits, research and coding agents. Prices checked Nov 3 2026.
tools.video: $20 a month for AI? Here's what you get.

tools.name: Best AI for students
tools.what: Gemini: free upgraded plan for 1 year for verified students. ChatGPT: study mode with step-by-step hints. Claude: learning mode that asks questions like a tutor.
tools.video: The best AI for students might not be yours.

tools.name: Voyager
tools.what: Folders, a timeline and export for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, AI Studio, DeepSeek and Kimi. Free, open source (GPL-3.0).
tools.video: Your AI chats are a mess. This fixes it.

tools.name: Taste Skill
tools.what: Gives Claude Code or Codex an art direction, real photos from open archives and a real-browser check, so AI-built sites stop looking the same. MIT. A build takes 30-45 min and many tokens.
tools.video: Why every AI-built site looks the same.

tools.name: Nanobrowser
tools.what: Free, open-source AI agent in your own browser: reads pages, clicks, types, switches tabs; asks before submitting and hands passwords and payments to you. Bring your own AI key or a local model.
tools.video: An AI that uses your browser for you.

tools.name: DESIGN.md Extractor
tools.what: Chrome extension that reads a site's fonts, colors and spacing and writes a DESIGN.md or SKILL.md for Claude Code, Codex or Google Stitch. MIT. Use for inspiration, not to clone brands.
tools.video: Copy any site's style into your AI.

tools.name: BrowserSkill
tools.what: From Tencent: connects Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to your real Chrome or Edge with your logins, in its own window you can take over. Export tables as JSON/CSV. MIT.
tools.video: Your coding agent can use your real browser.
